prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide, not a background asset and not a collage.
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 presentation slide for the cover page.
Communication purpose: 建立发布主张
Single claim: AI 客服，把每一次提问变成下一步行动
Audience: 产品市场团队、业务负责人和客户体验团队
Theme architecture: campaign; spatial grammar = 以单一传播主体为中心，用高识别度构图把主张快速推向观众; reading order = 先识别主体和主张，再读取最少量的支持信息; density strategy = 低密度、高识别，信息不能削弱第一眼的传播焦点; deck rhythm = 以强封面、产品主体、短主张和行动收束形成传播节奏.
Theme style: campaign/bold-poster; art direction = confident contemporary campaign poster with one recognizable product or service subject and disciplined graphic energy; palette = warm white, ink black, vermilion red, cobalt blue and one restrained lime accent; typography = bold modern Chinese sans serif for the conclusion with compact neutral sans support and deliberate line breaks; materials = flat printed color fields, crisp crop edges, subtle coated-paper grain and controlled studio light; text layout = use a clear medium or large conclusion with compact supporting copy; a page may be a poster statement, a product caption or an integrated claim rather than a giant headline.
Visual scheme: campaign/bold-poster/poster-claim; composition = one confident conclusion in a flat color field with a single graphic mark and a restrained secondary subject; imagery = poster geometry, cropped object silhouette or abstract service gesture; no extra campaign copy; requirements = one message dominates; color contrast remains readable in projection.
Title treatment: {"mode":"hero","scale":"medium-to-large","placement":"top-left","weight":"bold conclusion with compact support"}; a page may use a medium conclusion, statement, caption or integrated text instead of an oversized title.
Frozen layout plan: text safe zone = top-left; visual zone = center, right; hierarchy = headline, campaign-mark, supporting-line; density = low.
Scene and visual brief: 平面传播海报：一个抽象服务入口和明确的红蓝色块形成第一视觉焦点，不生成品牌 Logo 或额外广告文案。
Text (verbatim; render every line exactly once, with correct Chinese characters and punctuation):
1. "AI 客服，把每一次提问变成下一步行动"
2. "从回答开始，走向协作"
Evidence constraints (do not turn evidence into extra visible labels unless it is also in exact_text): []
Typography: use the specified Chinese type pairing and a readable hierarchy; keep line breaks intentional; do not force every page into a giant headline and do not shrink text to fit.
Text safety: ink-black or bone-white text on a flat, quiet color field; keep product edges and bright highlights away from letters; no face, object, highlight, grid, or light path may pass behind the letters.
Information boundary: use only the supplied visible text; do not invent metrics, labels, citations, UI, logos, product screens, names, dates, or claims.
Constraints: render the complete slide as one finished image; preserve a clear visual hierarchy; keep generous margins; use one dominant visual anchor; no editable UI; no watermark; no logo.
Avoid: multiple slogans; invented campaign labels; decorative logo lockups; generic corporate stock photo; fake brand logo; unverified product specifications; crowded ad copy; oversized title on every page; extra words; misspelled Chinese; gibberish; tiny labels; dense card grids; busy detail behind text; decorative pseudo-data.
Continuity anchor: campaign-mark; continuity group: cover.
